dict.string: Maritime Operations reads the phone position only when you turn on Phone position. That is not the ship's DP position. You can type a place instead.
Maritime Operations uses the camera only when you add a photo to a rig move. Photos stay on that move and are not part of any hours export.
Maritime Operations reads your photo library only when you pick a photo for a rig move. Photos stay on that move and are not part of any hours export.
